title: Beyond “Usability and User Experience”, Towards an Integrative Heuristic Inspection: from Accessibility to Persuasiveness in the UX Evaluation: A Case Study on an Insurance Prospecting Tablet Application
reasoning: The paper focuses on User Experience (UX) evaluation methodologies, specifically proposing an integrative heuristic inspection framework for a tablet application. It evaluates aspects like accessibility, usability, and persuasiveness in design but does not address religion, faith, or ethical/moral systems.
